Most people think Intermediate SQL is about writing longer queries.
.
.
It isn't.

It's about writing smarter queries.

Save this cheatsheet.

1. Master Filtering & Sorting

☑ WHERE → Filter rows
☑ ORDER BY → Sort results
☑ LIMIT → Return specific rows
☑ DISTINCT → Remove duplicate records

2. Aggregate Data

☑ COUNT() → Count records
☑ GROUP BY → Group similar records
☑ HAVING → Filter grouped results
